title: Thought Economics (Dr. Vikas Shah MBE DL) — Eric: 'Governance is not bureaucracy — it is the most important product a founder will ever design'
summary: Dr. Vikas Shah MBE DL — Manchester-based businessman, philosopher and host of Thought Economics, with 600+ long-form interviews spanning Nobel laureates, heads of state and cultural icons — publishes a 30-minute pre-launch interview with Eric on Incorruptible, covering governance as design work and the spiritual holding company.
blockquote: Governance is not bureaucracy — it is the most important product a founder will ever design.
